notes.title: Update 2.2.5
notes.notes:
Ahoy Seaorama Captains! ⚓️

We’re excited to announce that Update 2.2.5 for Seaorama: World of Shipping is now live! This update includes essential fixes and enhancements to improve your gameplay experience. Here's what's new:

🆕 New Features


 New log entry when a ship travels to a port for repairs.
 New Security insurance calculations. Now the cost is only for the trip leading to the port affected by piracy.
 New R&D window. Unlock upgrades through research to install on your ships and meet the requirements of the crew members. (R&D is available only when you start a new game session. Older saves will use the old format.)
 A new way of calculating the value of a share of a port, making it more affordable to invest.
 Added new column with Net Profit visible at Finance & Accounts.


🔧 Fixes and Improvements


 Improved Details at the Crew Members profile window. Know from before what upgrades to the ship each member will demand at each level and plan ahead with the new R&D department.
 Improved Details considering the percentage of event avoidance a crew member offers at the Crew Members profile window.
 Improved Port Investments window. See which ports sell shares, and know their ranking before investing. You can now also sell your shares from one port if you need money to invest elsewhere. AI companies can also buy shares, so be vigilant when new shares become available.
 Fix incomes/outcomes bugs.
 Fix Charter contract bug.
 Workshop packages hotfixes.
 Better breakdown for percentage and full amount of fuel at the Fuel window in Operations.
 Changes to Contract bonuses for the Game modes. Easy Mode now gets +60%, Medium Mode gets +30%, and Hard Mode (plus Ranked Mode) gets no bonuses from the contracts.


We’re committed to continually improving Seaorama: World of Shipping and appreciate your feedback. Enjoy the new features and fixes in this latest update!

The Seaorama Team 🚢💙

notes.title: Patch 2.2.4
notes.notes:
Hey Captains ,

We’ve just released a new update — Version 2.2.4 — focused on bug fixes, improvements, and clearer guidelines for content creation. This patch addresses several gameplay issues and adds new information to help creators build better packages.

Fixes and Improvements


Fixed trip days calculation to ensure more accurate scheduling.
 Fixed issue where fuel was incorrectly displayed after refueling during a trip stop.
Adjusted charterers' contracts for better balance and consistency.
Rearranged ship type ordering in certain UI windows for better clarity.


Workshop Guidelines Update


We've added new guidelines directly in the Workshop to help you understand what makes a good custom package.
The "Fact" section is now optional — it’s no longer a required field in custom package submissions.


These updates aim to improve the overall user experience and make it easier to create and manage content within the community.

Thanks for your continued feedback and support!

notes.title: 2.2 VERSION IS OUT!
notes.notes:
Hey Captains, 

After months of development, we’re excited to roll out the biggest update yet — Version 2.2.1 is now live on Steam. This release brings a major expansion to how you play, including a full custom content system, gameplay improvements, and quality of life upgrades. Let’s take a look. 🚀

🛠️ Custom Content System: Your World, Your Rules

One of the most requested features has been the ability to customize the game world, and we’ve delivered a system built entirely around flexibility and creativity.


 Add or remove ports at will,

 Customize ports with a name, description, and specific port type,

 Define the available products in every port,

 Create custom in-game events and set when and how they appear,

 Change the map’s visual style using selectable themes,


This system is modular. You can mix and match content from different creators, combine your own designs with others’, and build entirely new gameplay experiences tailored to your vision.


🌐 Community Sharing and Syncing

You can now easily share and explore custom content across the community:


 Upload and share ports, events, and map themes,

 Browse and download community creations directly in-game,




⚙️ Gameplay and Quality of Life Updates 

Version 2.2.1 brings dozens of improvements to make gameplay smoother and more enjoyable:


 Game speed increased by 25% for faster progression

 Quick sell and scrap options in the ship operations screen

 Smoother zooming and bug fixes for map navigation

 New crew morale filter: Red → Yellow → Green,

 Double-click a ship to open its operations view,

 Upgrade indicators for eligible crew members,

 Indicator for new managers CV's,

 One-click refill and repair to maximum,

 Toggle ship names on or off in the map view,

 Automatic scrapping of retired ships,

 Brighter hover highlights in ship list,

 Search bar added to ship operations,

 Use arrow keys to navigate the map,




Dive in, explore the tools, create your world, and share it with others.
Post here your custom package ⁠workshop-packages 

Thank you for being part of this amazing community. We can’t wait to see what you build!

notes.title: Patch 2.1.3 - QoL Updates!
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to announce that Seaorama: World of Shipping Version 2.1.3 is live! This update brings several fixes, features, and quality of life improvements, many of which were suggested by you! Here's what's new:
    🔧 Fixes & Optimizations            Managers: Managers will now ensure ships are maintained at an overall condition of 90% or higher, up from the previous 50%, ensuring that your fleet remains in top shape.        Ship Events: Adjustments have been made to balance the occurrence of ship events (looking at you, Windlasses!) even on fully upgraded ships with experienced crews.        Crew Resigning: The resignation countdown will now only start when a ship is idle and will reset with every trip. Ships with low-morale crew members will be unable to take new contracts, but they can still use the "Add to Queue" option to move to a nearby shipyard for repairs or upgrades.        🌟 General Improvements            Sell / Bid UI: We've added the ability to add/subtract 10M in the UI for faster input when adjusting amounts.        Filters: A new "Hide Filtered Ships" option has been added to the main screen, allowing you to hide selected ships (such as Managed ships) from the map.        Facilities: Just like the Ship Upgrades tab, there is now a single button to enable all facilities at once, streamlining the upgrade process.        Contracts Flat Fee: By popular demand, we’ve added a filtering option for the Flat Fee. You can now view the Flat Fee of a contract as Total Fee, Per Day, or Per Mile, depending on your preference.        New Ship Notification: When a new ship is ready to sail, a notification will now appear at the center of your screen, replacing the smaller notification that previously appeared on the right side for a more prominent alert.        
We hope you enjoy these new features and improvements. As always, thank you for your feedback and support! Keep sailing and optimizing your fleets in Seaorama: World of Shipping.
    
Fair winds and following seas,
    The Seaorama Team 🚢💙

notes.title: Update 2.0!
notes.notes:
🚢 Release of Update 2.0 - Our Biggest Update Yet! 🌊    
Ahoy, Seaorama Captains! ⚓️
    
We’re thrilled to announce that the much-anticipated Update 2.0 for Seaorama: World of Shipping is now live! This major update is packed with exciting new features and improvements to enhance your maritime adventure. Here's what's new:
    🛠️ Operation Window            Complete Redesign: Experience more control from a single interface, with operations and chartering now merged for seamless management.        Enhanced Map Features: View your ship's full path directly on the map, ensuring smoother navigation.        Automation Controls: Enjoy more automation options to streamline your operations, such as auto-fueling and repairs for all ships.        Contract Filtering: Hide unsuitable orders for your ships with the new filter option, making contract management more efficient.        👥 HR Enhancements            New HR Window: Manage multiple ship crews easily from one place, with the addition of managers and advisors.        Manager Roles: Hire managers who will control several ships and make decisions based on their philosophy, providing strategic benefits.        Advisor Roles: Advisors will boost your company in various areas such as research and efficiency.        Salary Adjustments: All crew salaries have been updated for better balance, reflecting their skills and experience.        Detailed CV View: A new window to view each crew member's CV in more detail, including their history and events.        Contract Breaks: Crew can break contracts if their morale is low or requirements are unmet, adding a realistic challenge to crew management.        Crew Requirements: Higher status ships now have minimum crew requirements based on their star rating, ensuring optimal performance.        🏗️ Port Enhancements            Redesigned Port UI: Fully revamped for a better user experience, with a cleaner and more intuitive layout.        Port Investments: Invest in ports and acquire shares to unlock more benefits and income, making ports a strategic part of your business.        🔍 Search Improvements            Fuel Price Display: Fuel prices are now included in the search results for better planning and cost management during voyages.        ⚓ Shipyards            Shipyard Selection: Choose from different shipyards, each with varying delays and prices for ordering new ships, allowing for more strategic decisions based on your needs.        🗺️ Main Map Updates            Filtering Options: Easily filter the shortlist to show only idle ships or those with events or crew issues, improving fleet management.        Auction List: Check and bid on auctions directly from the main game interface, making it easier to acquire new ships and equipment.        Crew Event Icons: Crew icons now appear next to ships needing rehiring, providing quick visual cues for crew management.        🌍 Additional Features            Competitor Information: Mouseover competitors' ships for detailed information, gaining insights into their operations.        Ship Distance Stats: Track the total distance traveled for each ship in the Finances and Accounts section, helping you monitor performance.        Company Metrics: View the total distance traveled during the company’s lifetime in the Company Details section, showcasing your overall progress.        
We can’t wait for you to explore all these fantastic new features. Set sail in this new era of Seaorama: World of Shipping and enjoy the adventure! 🌟
    
Fair winds and following seas,
    The Seaorama Team 🚢💙

notes.title: Upcoming Patch 2.0
notes.notes:
Hello, Seaorama Captains!

We're eager to give you a sneak peek into what's on the horizon for Seaorama: World of Shipping. Our team is hard at work on Patch 2.0, set to bring a tide of updates and enhancements to your gaming experience in the near future!
[hr][/hr]
🌟 User Interface Revolution: Get ready for a completely revamped UI that's more intuitive and streamlined. The integration of operation and chartering windows and a redesigned minimap will make managing your maritime empire easier and more enjoyable.

🚢 Operation and Chartering Evolutions: We're elevating operations to a new level. More detailed crew management, strategic chartering with an expanded map, and automated options for fuel and repair are just a few of the improvements we're fine-tuning.

👥 HR and Crew Management Overhaul: The roles of operation managers and advisors are being expanded for greater strategic depth. Our enhanced HR system will allow for more detailed crew management, including comprehensive histories and salary management.

🌐 Search and Event Enhancements: The search function is getting a major upgrade for a more immersive port discovery experience. Plus, brace yourself for an influx of new ship and global events that will challenge your strategic skills.

🏗️ Shipyard and Main Map Updates: Selecting shipyards will soon reflect more real-world economic conditions. The main map will feature improved filtering options for better fleet management.

🎉 Additional Improvements: We're introducing a revamped auction system, a new fleet reward system, and numerous other enhancements to enrich your gameplay experience. Expect smoother navigation, enhanced information access, and many more features that we're excited for you to explore.
[hr][/hr]
Stay tuned as we finalize these exciting updates. We can't wait for you to set sail in this new era of Seaorama: World of Shipping!

The Seaorama Team 🚢💙

notes.title: Patch 1.06 🛠
notes.notes:
Seaorama Game Update👾    

Hello, Seaorama Players!😊

We're excited to announce our latest game updates, which includes several optimizations, game changes, and bug fixes. Our team has worked hard to enhance your gaming experience, and we're thrilled to share the details with you.

🔧Optimization🔧

Build Size Reduction: We've significantly reduced the game's build size from 6GB to 2.1GB, making it lighter and faster to download.
Memory Usage: There's now a 40% reduction in memory usage, ensuring a smoother and more efficient gameplay experience.
🎮Game Changes🎮

Event Limitation Per Ship: We've decreased and set a limit to the events that can happen per ship during a trip, streamlining the gameplay and making it more manageable.       
 Color-Coded Ship Status: To help players quickly understand the status of each ship, we've added color coding:
       
              
   Red: Indicates something bad has happened.
   White: The ship is idle.
   Green: The ship is performing all calculated procedures as expected.         
        Contract Acquisition on Route: Players can now acquire contracts while their ship is en route, adding more strategic depth to the game.

Tugboat Travel: Fixed an issue where tugboats were traveling through land.
Ship Response Post-Charter: Improved the ship's response behavior after a charter is finished.

 Load Session & Ship Freezing: Addressed rare cases where loading a session was broken or a ship would freeze and display incorrect crew messages.

Fair winds and following seas!

notes.title: SeaOrama: World of Shipping is Charting a Course to PC Release
notes.notes:
PID Games publishing label is partnering up with Hidden Tower, an indie game development studio, to bring back the entrepreneurial spirit through management and simulation game SeaOrama: World of Shipping. 
 
So, we are delighted to announce that SeaOrama will be releasing this year on PC. Meanwhile to make it worth your wait, we will be releasing a Steam Demo for SeaOrama during our participation in the Steam Next Fest from 9th- 16th October 2023.

DEMO SETS SAIL: October 9th 2023!

Experience the challenges of running a successful shipping company with Seaorama: World of Shipping. In Seaorama, you'll have access to a fleet of over 17 types of ships and 90 port locations. But getting goods from one port to another is just the beginning…

Start Your Own Shipping Company 

Embark on a thrilling entrepreneurial journey as you establish and nurture your very own shipping company in Seaorama: World of Shipping. Begin with a single vessel and transform it into a maritime empire. Strategize, invest wisely, and watch your company grow from humble beginnings to a dominant force in the global trade arena. 

Plan Trade Routes Between 90 Port Locations 

Create your own trade routes across an expansive world map featuring 90 port locations. Each destination offers unique challenges and opportunities. Analyze market trends, factor in geopolitical events, and master the art of logistics to optimize your routes for maximum profitability and efficiency. 

Manage Your Ships & Contracts 

Take control of a versatile fleet comprising 17 types of vessels. From cargo vessels to container ships, ensure that your fleet is well-maintained and equipped. Strike lucrative contracts with clients and meticulously oversee every aspect of your shipping operations. Adapt to unforeseen challenges and keep your cargo moving, no matter what obstacles arise.

And Rise as the Shipping Industry's Next Kingpin

Dive into the deep end of maritime adventure and navigate your way to success in this oceanic venture. SeaOrama invites players to chart their course, master the tides, and ride the currents of commerce in a captivating world where every decision holds the key to maritime magnificence.

Play the Demo and Wishlist Now:
